data.name: Afnin
data.gender_notes: Afnin is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Afnin is a beautiful Quranic name for girls meaning 'branches of trees in Paradise'. It signifies beauty, natural elegance, and divine creation. The name Afnin carries the meaning “Branches of Heaven, Beauty, Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Afnin usually hope their child will grow to embody branches of heaven, beauty, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes paradise, purity, and the extension of divine mercy — a soul that blossoms with grace.
data.etymology: Afnin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Branches of Heaven, Beauty, Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afnin total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أفنين
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أفنين مشتق من الفنن، وهو الغصن الأخضر، والأفنان هي الأغصان الخضراء المتفتحة، ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنبياء، الآية 30: 'وَأَفْنَانًا وَنَخْلًا زَعْلًا'، يدل على الخصوبة والنماء، ويحمل معاني الازدهار والتفتح

in_urdu.name: افنین
in_urdu.meaning: خزاں سے بھری، سبز شاخیں، نباتات
in_urdu.long_meaning: افنین نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ 'فنن' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے سبز شاخ یا غصن، اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا ذکر انبیاء سورہ، آیت 30 میں کیا گیا ہے: 'وَأَفْنَانًا وَنَخْلًا زَعْلًا'، یہ نام خصوبة، نمو اور روحانی غذا کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: अफनिन
in_hindi.meaning: हरियाली से भरा, हरी शाखाएं, पौधे
in_hindi.long_meaning: अफनिन नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है 'हरियाली' या 'निम्न शाखाएं', इस्लामी परंपरा में, इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में सूरह अनबिया, आयत 30 में मिलता है: 'وَأَفْنَانًا وَنَخْلًا زَعْلًا'। यह नाम आध्यात्मिक विकास और समृद्धि का प्रतीक है

in_pashto.name: افنین
in_pashto.long_meaning: افنین نوم د عربیو کلمو 'فنن' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د شنبلیو یا شینوالی دي، په قرآن کریم کې د انبیاء سوره، آیت 30 کې راغلی دی: 'وَأَفْنَانًا وَنَخْلًا زَعْلًا'، دا نوم د زړه پورې او روحاني پرمختګ نښه ده

in_english.name: Afnin
in_english.meaning: Flourishing branches, green shoots, plant growth
in_english.long_meaning: The name Afnin originates from Arabic roots, specifically from 'fanana', meaning a green branch or shoot. It is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Anbiya, verse 30: 'وَأَفْنَانًا وَنَخْلًا زَعْلًا', symbolizing fertility, growth, and spiritual nourishment. This name carries connotations of abundance, prosperity, and renewal

data.cultural_impact: The name Afnin holds a unique significance in Islamic culture, as its meaning is derived directly from the Quran. The image of the branches of trees in paradise speaks to the Islamic belief in eternal life and the beauty and richness of the afterlife. It also reinforces the importance of nature and the natural world in Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Afnin lies in the promises made in the Quran about the beauty and riches of paradise. It serves as a reminder of the rewards that await the faithful in the afterlife, and inspires hope and motivation to live a virtuous and righteous life in this world. The branches of trees in paradise also represent the idea of growth, renewal, and the continued development of one's spiritual self. Overall, the name Afnin inspires a sense of beauty, natural elegance, and divine creation, both in this world and in the next.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Afnin is an Arabic name meaning "grace, kindness, and charm." It is believed that those named Afnin possess a gentle spirit and are naturally compassionate and generous. They are often seen as being blessed with the ability to bring joy and beauty into the lives of others.
